rv.q: There's not much to critique here; CLUE is just fun.
The creative elements and fantastic cast are a delight to behold, resulting in this unmissable 80-minute whodunnit.
In Clue, secret agendas, grizzly murders, secret identities, and things that go bump in the night come together with side-splitting wackiness for an enthrallingly goofy spoof of the mystery genre.
Let me preface this by saying, it was not necessary to bring the film to the stage.
The set itself is a spectacle, and sometimes we'll hear the audience gasp when a change happens.
Instead, it is slapstick on steroids, leaning into puns, physical comedy, and silly antics that work hard for the laughs.

cn.t: Critics praise this spirited adaptation of the beloved board game and film, celebrating its clever comedy and playful send-up of mystery genre conventions that delivers entertaining fun for audiences.
